The Arvest Cash Back Credit Card pays a $200 new account rewards cash bonus after spending $1,000 on eligible purchases within the first 93 days of account opening (fees, interest, balance transfers, cash advances and cash equivalents excluded). The bonus is awarded as $200 rewards cash in the Arvest Flex Rewards program and is applied within 3 full billing cycles after the qualifying purchases; the account must be open and not in default when applied. 0% intro APR on purchases and balance transfers for 18 billing cycles, then 18.24% - 24.99% variable APR. Distinct from the Arvest Cobalt Visa Signature (verified separately as R5383) - different card, different rewards structure. Treat the bonus as a one-time boost, not income.
